Text: Dust on Mars is no joke.

Text: I mean, for Ginny, there are two big problems.

Text: First, dust is a problem

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: So she's able to keep flying, albeit wounded.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: And survival isn't getting any easier.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: See, every Martian night,

Text: the temperature drops precipitously.

Text: My friend Alex from the channel Astrum describes it well.

Text: With less atmosphere,

Text: Mars became far worse at retaining heat.

Text: When the surface starts to cool,

Text: there is no air to catch the escaping warmth.

Text: It is at the point where,

Text: your feet might feel 23 degrees Celsius,

Text: while at your head, it would be 0 degrees Celsius.

Text: Mars has some intense temperature swings.

Text: Temperatures there now range from highs of around 27 degrees Celsius

Text: If you want to learn more about how this leads to

Text: entire planet-covering dust storms,

Text: Astrum has a whole video on the Martian climate.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: So these massive shifts in temperature

Text: are happening all the time.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: But as Ginny's mission progresses,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Mars gets farther away from the Sun

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: and enters the Martian winter.

Text: So it gets even colder at night,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: which is a problem.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Many of Ingenuity's key electrical components

Text: are hand-soldered.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: And big temperature swings cause

Text: expansion and contraction of this metal.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: And so that can eventually break these connections.

Text: Also, inside the batteries,

Text: a liquid electrolyte solution allows lithium ions

Text: during charging and discharging.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: But if this solution freezes,

Text: JPL fears that the whole thing will stop working entirely.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: So what they do is keep all the components

Text: sensitive to the cold inside a warm box,

Text: which has resistance heaters that run during the night.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: You might spend 25 or 30% of your battery flying,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: and the other 60 to 75% is all just staying warm at night.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: The problem is, the colder it gets,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: the harder the heaters have to work.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: And if they can't keep up,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: and the batteries cool too much,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: they become less efficient.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: So they supply even less power to the heaters.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Performance can continue to degrade

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: in a vicious death spiral.

Text: Is this the end of the mission?

Text: The way she was designed,

Text: Ginny has an alarm clock that wakes her up.

Text: It stays awake for 15 minutes.

Text: If it doesn't hear anything after 15 minutes,

Text: it goes back to sleep.

Text: Then it doesn't wake up until the next alarm.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Their hypothesis is this.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: If the lack of sunlight forced Ginny

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: to fully deplete her batteries,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: then during the night,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: her heaters would have stopped,

Text: and she would have powered off completely.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: When the sun rises,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: as long as her essential components stay on,

Text: she may recharge enough to wake up.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Only now her clock will have reset.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: So they run the calculations.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: If she's still alive,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: based on when the sun comes up,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: she should be waking up at 11.45 a.m. Martian time.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: That is not the time they had been trying.

Text: So they change their search window

Text: and start calling out to Ginny

Text: around when they expect her to power up.

Text: They send out ping after ping,

Text: until finally...

Text: she's alive!

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: They check to see whether everything is still working.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: And despite the components in her warm box

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: only being rated to negative 45 degrees,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: they survive being completely frozen.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Well, all except for one.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: The inclinometer is dead.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: The inclinometer is what lets Ingenuity

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: know her physical orientation in 3D space before flight.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: And that is pretty essential for getting the right heading.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: You can imagine if you're off and heading,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: by 10 degrees you could fly into a mountain.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Without the inclinometer,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: there is no way for her to fly.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: So at first, the whole team is stumped.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: But then they have an idea.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Because Ingenuity is made of phone parts.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Literally, parts from phones people carry around every day.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Her processor is from a Samsung Galaxy S5.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: And some of her sensors are from a Google Pixel 3.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: And these phones can do a lot of the things

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: that an inclinometer can do.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Inside every smartphone are at least

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: three little micro-electromechanical systems

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: aligned perpendicular to each other.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Like X, Y, Z.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: At their core is a small mass suspended by flexible arms.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: They work like springs and follow Hooke's law,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: F equals minus KX,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: where force is proportional to displacement.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: The mass also follows Newton's second law,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: F equals MA.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: If you combine these equations,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: you get A equals minus KX over M,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: which links acceleration and displacement.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Surrounding the mass are fixed arms.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: When a voltage is applied to the mass and arms,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: they form a capacitor,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: where epsilon and A stay constant.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: But as the mass moves,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: the distance between them changes with X.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: This alters the capacitance,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: which becomes more noticeable with multiple plates.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Hence why they have so many little arms.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: By measuring capacitance,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: you can determine displacement.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: And since displacement is proportional to acceleration,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: changes in capacitance,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: allow us to measure acceleration.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: That's why these devices are called accelerometers.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: And by integrating acceleration over time,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: you can work out velocity and then position.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: This is how motion tracking works

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: for screen rotation, gaming controls, and step counting.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: If you add gyroscopes,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: you get an inertial measurement unit, or IMU.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: And Ingenuity has the same IMU as the Google Pixel 3.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: So the team at JPL had an idea.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: They could reprogram the computer

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: to use the IMU to replace the inclinometer.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: The inclinometer is really just accelerometers

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: that allows us to tell the initial attitude of the vehicle

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: in roll and pitch.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: And the IMU also has accelerometers.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: So in principle, it gives you the same information.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: So from the clutches of failure,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: they get her running again.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: We got lucky in that, like,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: the one instrument we could afford to lose

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: was the one that died.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: But the IMU isn't space grade.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: In fact, none of these off-the-shelf parts are,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: which means they're vulnerable to cosmic rays.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: On Mars, the thin atmosphere

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: doesn't just make it harder to fly.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: It also means cosmic rays reach the surface more easily.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: And a single cosmic ray can strike a computer register

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: and flip a bit inside the computer,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: which can lead to some strange behavior.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: It even happens here on Earth.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: It once added 4,096 unaccounted votes

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: to a candidate in a Belgian election.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Now, on a Martian helicopter,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: flipping the wrong bit at the wrong time

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: could mean losing control and crashing.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: So why doesn't that happen?

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: If you asked somebody 10 years ago,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: can you fly just the latest cell phone processor,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: they'd be like, nah, it'll last like two days

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: and you'll be dead, right?

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Turns out that cosmic ray bit flips

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: are not as big a deal as NASA thought.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: The off-the-shelf components hold up way better

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: than they expected.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: And this is an important finding.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: Rather than going through all of the development cost

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: of building up a processor from scratch

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: to be radiation tolerant,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: what we're finding is you get a lot better bang for your buck

Text: by just going and basically buying batches

Text: of different processors and just qualling them.

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: That means throw them through a radiation test campaign,

Filename: 30Min.mp4
Text: look at the failure rates,

Text: and figuring out, hey, this guy, we don't know why,

Text: but for whatever reason, this processor over here is great.

Text: It holds up. So we'll fly that.

Text: And then more recently,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Because I want to say that much the same thing is true of religions.

Text: Religions are natural phenomena.

Text: And you might say it's about the reverse engineering of religions.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And that is the spell that I want to break.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We should study them with the same intensity that we study all the other important natural phenomena.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Like global warming, as we heard so eloquently last night from Al Gore.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Today's religions are brilliantly designed.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Brilliantly designed.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: They are immensely powerful social institutions,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and many of their features can be traced back to earlier features

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And as with the cow,

Text: there's a mixture of evolution,

Text: designed by natural selection itself,

Text: and intelligent design,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and redesigned by human beings

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: who are trying to redesign their religions.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So this is,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: you don't do book talks at TED,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: but I'm going to have just one slide about my book,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: because there's one message in it

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: which I think this group really needs to hear,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and I would be very interested to get your responses to this.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It's the one policy proposal that I make in the book

Text: at this time,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: when I claim not to know enough about religion

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to know what other policy proposals to make,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and it's one that echoes

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: remarks that you've heard already today.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Here's my proposal.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I'm going to just take a couple of minutes to explain it.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: That education in world religions,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: on world religions,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: for all of our children,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: in primary school,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: in high school,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: in public schools,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: in private schools,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and in home schooling.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So what I'm proposing is,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: just as we require reading, writing, arithmetic,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: about all the religions of the world,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: about their history,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: about their creeds,

Text: their music,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: their symbolisms,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: their prohibitions,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: their requirements.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And that this should be presented factually,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: straightforwardly,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: with no particular spin,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to all of the children in the country.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And, as long as you teach them that,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: you can teach them anything else you like.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: That, I think, is maximal tolerance for religious freedom.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: As long as you inform your children about other religions,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: then you may,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and as early as you like,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and whatever you like,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: teach them whatever creed you want them to learn,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: but also let them know about other religions.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now, why do I say that?

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Because democracy depends on an informed citizenship.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Informed consent is the very bedrock

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: of our understanding of democracy.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Misinformed consent is not worth it.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It's like a coin flip.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It's just not,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: it doesn't count, really.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Democracy depends on informed consent.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: This is the way we treat people

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: as responsible adults.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now, children,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: below the age of consent,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: are a special case.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Parents,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I'm going to use a word that Pastor Rick just used,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: parents are stewards of their children.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: They don't own them.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: You can't own your children.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: You have a responsibility to the world,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to the state,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to them,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to take care of them right.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: You may teach them whatever creed you think is most important,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: but I say you have a responsibility

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to let them be informed about all the other creeds in the world, too.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now, what,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: the reason I've taken this time is

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I've been fascinated to hear some of the reactions to this.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: One reviewer

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: for a Roman Catholic newspaper called it totalitarian.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It strikes me as practically libertarian.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Is it totalitarian to require reading, writing, and arithmetic?

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I don't think so.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: All I'm saying is,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and facts,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: facts only,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: no values,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: just facts,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: facts about all the world's religions.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Another reviewer called it hilarious.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Well,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I'm really bothered by the fact

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that anybody would think that was hilarious.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It seems to me to be such a plausible,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: natural extension of the democratic principles we already have

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that I'm shocked to think anybody would find that just ridiculous.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I know,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: many religions

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: are so anxious

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: about preserving the purity of their faith among their children

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that they are intent

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: on keeping their children ignorant of other faiths.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I don't think that's defensible.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But I'd really be pleased to get your answers on that.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Any reactions to that later.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But now I'm going to move on.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Back to the cow.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: This picture, which I pulled off the web,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: the fellow on the left is really an important part of this picture.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: That's the steward.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Cows couldn't live without human stewards.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: They're domesticated.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: They're a sort of ecto-symbiont.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: They depend on us for their survival.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And Pastor Rick was just talking about sheep.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I'm going to talk about sheep too.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: There's a lot of serendipitous convergence here.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: How clever it was of sheep to acquire shepherds.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Think of what this got them.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: They could outsource all their problems.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Protection from predators,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: food finding,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: health maintenance.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: The only cost in most flocks,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: not even this,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: a loss of free mating.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: What a deal.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: How clever of sheep,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: you might say.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Except, of course, it wasn't the sheep's cleverness.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We all know sheep are not exactly rocket scientists.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: They're not very smart.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It wasn't the cleverness of the sheep at all.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: They were clueless.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But it was a very clever move.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Whose clever move was it?

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It was a clever move of natural selection itself.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Francis Crick,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: the co-discoverer of the structure of DNA with Jim Watson,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: once joked about what he thought was a very clever move.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: He led the line in a conversation that he called

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Orgel's Second Rule.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Leslie Orgel is still a molecular biologist,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: bright guy...

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And Orgel's Second Rule is

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: evolution is cleverer than you are.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now that is not intelligent design.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Not from Francis Crick.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Evolution is cleverer than you are.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: If you understand Orgel's Second Rule,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: you'll understand why the intelligent design

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: movement is basically a hoax.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But our...

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: The designs discovered by the process of natural selection are brilliant, unbelievably brilliant.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Again and again, biologists are fascinated with the brilliance of what's discovered.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But the process itself is without purpose, without foresight, without design.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: When I was here four years ago, I told a story about an ant climbing a blade of grass.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And why was the ant doing it was because its brain had been infected with a lancet fluke

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that was needed to get into the belly of a sheep or a cow in order to reproduce.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It was sort of a spooky story.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I think some people may have misunderstood.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Lancet flukes aren't smart.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I submit that the intelligence of a lancet fluke is down there somewhere between petunia and carrot.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: They're not really bright.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: They don't have to be.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: The lesson we learn from this is you don't have to have a mind.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: To be a beneficiary.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: The design is there in nature, but it's not in anybody's head.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It doesn't have to be.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: That's the way evolution works.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Question, was domestication good for sheep?

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It was great for their genetic fitness.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And here I want to remind you of a wonderful point that Paul McCready made at TED three years ago.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Here's what he said.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: 10,000 years ago at the dawn of agriculture,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: human population plus livestock and pets

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: was approximately a tenth of one percent of the terrestrial vertebrate land mass.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: That was just 10,000 years ago.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Yesterday in biological terms.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: What is it today?

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Anybody remember what he told us?

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: That is what we have done on this planet.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now, I talked to Paul afterwards.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I wanted to check out to find out how he'd calculated this and get the sources and so forth.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And he also he gave me a paper that he had written on this and there was a passage in it which he did not.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I did not present here.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I think it is so good I'm going to read it to you.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Over billions of years on a unique sphere,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: chance has painted a thin covering of life.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Complex, improbable, wonderful and fragile.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Suddenly, we humans, a recently arrived species,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: no longer subject to the checks and balances inherent in nature,

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: have grown in population technology and intelligence to a position of terrible power.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We now wield the paintbrush.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We heard about the atmosphere as a

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: thin layer of varnish.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Life itself is just a thin coat of paint on this planet.

Filename: Dan Dennett- Let's teach religion -- all religion -- in schools - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And we're the ones that hold the paintbrush.

Text: This is Donna at the Statue of Liberty. This is Donna at the Statue of Liberty. This is

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Donna eating ice cream. And this is Donna teaching my aunt how to do a Filipino dance.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now I really think as the world is getting smaller, it becomes more and more important

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that we learn each other's dance moves, that we meet each other, we get to know each other.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We are able to figure out a way to cross borders, to understand each other, to understand people's

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: hopes and dreams, what makes them laugh and cry.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I know that we can't all do exchange programs. And I can't force everybody

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to travel. I've already talked about that to Chris and Amy. And they said that there's

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: a problem with this. You can't force people, free will. And I totally support that. So

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: we're not forcing people to travel. But I'd like to talk about another way to travel that

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: doesn't require a ship or an airplane and just requires a movie camera, a projector,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and a screen. And that's what I'm going to talk to you about today. I was asked that

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I speak a little bit about where I personally come from. And, you know, I think a lot of

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And Cameron, I don't know how you managed to get out of that one,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: but I think that building bridges is important to me

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: because of where I come from.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I'm the daughter of an American mother

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and an Egyptian-Lebanese-Syrian father,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: so I'm the living product of two cultures coming together,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: no pun intended.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I've also been called as an Egyptian-Lebanese-Syrian-American

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: with a Persian name, the Middle East Peace Crisis.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So maybe me starting to take pictures

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: was some kind of way to bring both sides of my family together,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: a way to take the worlds with me, a way to tell stories visually.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It all kind of started that way,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: but I think that I really realized the power of the image

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: when I first went to the garbage-collecting village in Egypt

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: when I was about 16.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: My mother took me there.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: She's somebody that believes strongly in community service

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and discipleship.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: She decided that this was something that I needed to do.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And so I went there, and I met some amazing women there.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: There were people who...

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: There was a center there where they were teaching people

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: how to read and write and get vaccinations

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: against so many diseases you can get from sorting through garbage.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I began to start teaching there.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I taught English, and I met some incredible women there.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I met people that lived seven people to a room,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: barely can afford their evening meal,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: yet lived with this strength,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and this strength of spirit and sense of humor

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and just incredible qualities.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I got drawn into this community, and I began to take pictures there.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I took pictures of weddings and older family members,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: things that they wanted memories of.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: About two years after I started taking these pictures,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: the UN Conference on Population and Development

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: asked me to show them at the conference.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I was 18. I was very excited.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It was my first exhibit of photographs,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and they were all put up there.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And after about two days, they all came down except for three.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: People were very upset, very angry

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that I was showing these dirty sides of Cairo,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and why didn't I cut the dead donkey out of the frame?

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And as I sat there, I got very depressed.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I looked at this big empty wall with, you know,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: three lonely people, and I was like,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I'm going to take these only photographs

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that were, you know, very pretty photographs.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I was like, I failed at this.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But I was looking at this intense emotion and intense feeling

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that had come out of people just seeing these photographs.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I mean, here I was, this 18-year-old pipsqueak

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that nobody listened to, and all of a sudden,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I put these photographs on the wall, and there were arguments,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and they had to be taken down, and I just saw the power of the image.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And it was incredible.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I think the most important reaction that I saw there

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: was actually people that would never have gone to the garbage village themselves,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that would never have seen that the human spirit

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: could thrive in such difficult circumstances.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I think it was at that point that I decided

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that I wanted to use photography and film

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to somehow bridge gaps, to bridge cultures,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: bring people together, cross borders.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And so that's what really kind of started me off.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I did a stint at MTV, made a film called Startup.com,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and then in about 2000, I worked on a couple of music films.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But in 2003, when the war in Iraq was about to start,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I felt...

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It was a very surreal feeling for me,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: because before the war started,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: there was kind of this media war that was going on.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I was watching television in New York,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and there seemed to be just one point of view that was coming across.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And it went from...

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: The coverage went from the US State Department

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to embedded troops.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And what was coming across on the news

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: was that there was going to be this clean war

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and precision bombings,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and the Iraqis would be greeting the Americans as liberators

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and throwing flowers at their feet in the streets of Baghdad.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I knew that there was a completely other story

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that was taking place in the Middle East, where my parents were.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I knew that there was a completely other story

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: being told, and I was thinking,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: how are people supposed to communicate with each other

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: when they're getting completely different messages,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and nobody knows what the other is being told?

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: How are people supposed to have any kind of common understanding

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: or know how to move together into the future?

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So I knew that I had to go there.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I just wanted to be in the center.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I had no plan, I had no funding.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I didn't even have a camera at the time.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I had somebody bring it there.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Because I wanted to get access to Al Jazeera,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: George Bush's son,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: George Bush's favorite channel,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: a place which I was very curious about

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: because it's disliked by many governments across the Arab world,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and also called the mouthpiece of Osama bin Laden

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: by some people in the US government.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So I was thinking, you know,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: this station that's hated by so many people

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: has to be doing something right.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I've got to go see what this is all about.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I also wanted to go see Central Command,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: which was ten minutes away.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And that way I could get access

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to how this news was being created.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: On the Arab side reaching the Arab world,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and on the US and Western side reaching the US.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And when I went there and sat there

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and met these people that were in the center of it,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and sat with these characters,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I met some surprising, very complex people.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I'd like to share with you a little bit

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: of that experience of when you sit with somebody

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and you film them and you listen to them

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and you allow them more than a five second sound bite,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: the amazing complexity of people emerge.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Business as usual.

Text: Iraq, and then Iraq, and then Iraq.

Text: But I also believe that

Text: He was in total pineapple debt.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: To me, that experience is very symbolic.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But most of it is family relationships,

Text: and I have many stereotypes.

Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: The night they showed the POWs and the dead soldiers, Al Jazeera showed them.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It was powerful because America doesn't show those kind of images.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Most of the news in America won't show really gory images.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And this showed American soldiers in uniform strewn about a floor, a coal-tile floor.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And it was revolting.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It was absolutely revolting.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It made me sick in my stomach.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And then what hit me was the night before there had been some kind of bombing in Basra.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And Al Jazeera had shown images of the people.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And they were equally, if not more, horrifying than the images were.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I remember having seen it in the Al Jazeera office and thought to myself, wow, that's gross.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: That's bad.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And then going away and probably eating dinner or something.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And, you know, it didn't affect me as much.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: The impact that had on me, me realizing that I just saw people on the other side.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And those people in the Al Jazeera office must have felt the way I was feeling that night.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And it upset me on a profound level that I wasn't as bothered as much the night before.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It makes me hate war.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But it doesn't make me believe that we're in a world that can live without war yet.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I was overwhelmed by the response of the film.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We didn't know whether it would be able to get out there.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We had no funds.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We didn't have funding for it.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We were incredibly lucky that it got picked up.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And when we showed the film in both the United States and the Arab world, we had such incredible reactions.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It was amazing to see how people were moved by this film.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: In the Arab world, and it's not really by the film.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It's by the characters.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I mean, Josh Rushing was this incredibly complex person who was thinking about things.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And when I showed the film in the Middle East, people said,

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: people wanted to meet Josh.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: He kind of redefined us as an American population.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: People started to ask me, where is this guy now?

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Jazir offered him a job.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And Samir, on the other hand, was also quite an interesting character for the Arab world to see.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Because it brought out the complexities of this love-hate relationship that the Arab world has with the West.

Filename: Jehane Noujaim- My wish- A global day of film - TED Talk.mp4
Text: In the United States, I was blown away by the...

Text: I'm going to show now the last project.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: This also was an unusual client.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: They inverted the whole idea of development.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: They came to us and they said, unlike normal developers,

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: they said, we want to start out with a project

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: by providing a contemporary art museum in Louisville.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: That's our main goal.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And so instead of being a developer that sees an opportunity

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to make money, they saw an ability to be a catalyst

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: in their downtown.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And the fact that they wanted to support the contemporary art museum

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: actually built their pro forma, so they worked in reverse.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And that pro forma led us to a mixed-use building

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that was very large in order to support their aspirations of the art,

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: but it also opened up opportunities for the art itself

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to collaborate, interact with commercial spaces

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that actually artists more and more want to work within.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And it also charged us with thinking about how to have something

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that was both a single building and a credible sort of sub-building.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So this is Louisville's skyline, and I'm going to take you through

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: the various constraints that led to the project.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: First, the physical constraints.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We actually had to operate on three discrete sites,

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: all of them well, well smaller than the size of the building.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We had to operate next to the new Muhammad Ali Center and respect it.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We had to operate within the 100-year framework

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: of the new floodplain.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now this area floods three to four times a year,

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and there's a levee behind our site similar to the ones that broke in New Orleans.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We had to operate behind the I-64 corridor,

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: a street that cuts through the middle of these separate sites.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So these were starting to build a sort of nightmare of constraints in a bathtub.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Underneath the bathtub are the city's main power lines,

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and there was a pedestrian corridor that they wanted to add

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that would link a series of cultural buildings.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And a view corridor, because this is the historic district

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that they didn't want to obstruct with the new building.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And now we're going to add 1.1 million square feet.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And if we did the traditional thing, that 1.1 million square feet,

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: these are the different programs.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Traditional thing would be to identify the public elements,

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: place them on sites, and now we'd have a really terrible situation,

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And we would create something that was unviable.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: In fact, and you know this, this is called the Time Warner Building.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So our strategy was very simple.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Just lift the entire block, flip some of the elements over,

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: reposition them so they have appropriate views and relationships to downtown,

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and make circulation connections and reroute the road.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So that's the basic concept.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now I'm going to show you what it leads to.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It seems a very formal, willful gesture,

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: but something derived entirely out of the constraints.

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And again, when we unveiled it, there was sort of nervousness

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now within that center zone, as I said,

Filename: Joshua Prince-Ramus- Behind the design of Seattle's library - TED Talk.mp4

Text: It also means if an artist wants to invade something like a swimming pool,
