Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: On September 10th, the morning of my seventh birthday,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I came downstairs to the kitchen where my mother was washing the dishes

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and my father was reading the paper or something,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and I sort of presented myself to them in the doorway,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and they said,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Hey, happy birthday!

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I said, I'm seven.

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And my father smiled and said,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Well, you know what that means, don't you?

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I said,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Yeah, that I'm going to have a party and a cake and get a lot of presents?

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And my dad said,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Well, yes, but more importantly, being seven means that you've reached the age of reason,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and you're now capable of committing any and all sins against God and man.

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now, I had heard this phrase, age of reason, before.

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Sister Mary Kevin had been banding it about my second grade class at school,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: but when she said it, the phrase seemed all caught up in the excitement of preparations

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: for our first birthday.

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I said,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Oh, my God, I'm so happy to be a part of the first communion and our first confession.

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And everybody knew that was really all about the white dress and the white veil.

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And anyway, I hadn't really paid all that much attention to that phrase, age of reason.

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So I said,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Yeah, yeah, age of reason.

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: What does that mean again?

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And my dad said,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Well, we believe in the Catholic Church that God knows that little kids don't know the difference

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: between right and wrong, but when you're seven, you're old enough to know better.

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So you've grown up and reached the age of reason,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and now God will start keeping notes on you and begin your permanent record.

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I said,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Oh, wait a minute.

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: You mean all that time up till today, all that time I was so good, God didn't notice it?

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And my mom said,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Well, I noticed it.

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I thought,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: How could I not have known this before?

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: How could it not have sunk in when they'd been telling me all that being good and no real credit for it?

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And worst of all, how could I not have realized this very important information

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: until the very day that it was basically useless to me?

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So I said,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Well, Mom and Dad, what about Santa Claus?

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I mean, Santa Claus knows if you're naughty or nice, right?

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And my dad said,

Filename: Julia Sweeney- Letting go of God - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Yeah, he knows.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I'm the luckiest guy in the world.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I got to see the last case of killer smallpox in the world.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I was in India this past year and I may have seen the last cases of polio in the world.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: There's nothing that makes you feel more the blessing and the honor of working in a program like that

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: than to know that something that horrible no longer exists.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So I'm going to show you some dirty pictures.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: They are difficult to watch, but you should look at them with optimism

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: because the horror of these pictures will be matched by the uplifting quality of knowing that they no longer exist.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But first, I'm going to show you a picture of a man who was killed in a war.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I'm going to tell you a little bit about my own journey.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: My background is not exactly the conventional medical education that you might expect.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: When I was an intern in San Francisco, I heard about a group of Native Americans

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: who had taken over Alcatraz Island and a Native American who wanted to give birth on that island

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and no other doctor wanted to go and help her give birth.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I went out to Alcatraz and I lived on the island for several weeks.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: She gave birth, I caught the baby, I got off the island, I landed in San Francisco

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and all the press wanted to talk to me because my three weeks on the island made me an expert in Indian affairs.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I wound up on every television show.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Someone saw me on television, they called me up and they asked me if I'd like to be in the movie

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and to play a young doctor for a bunch of rock and roll stars who were traveling in a bus ride from San Francisco to England.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I said, yes, I would do that.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So I became the doctor in Alcatraz.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I was in a movie, an absolutely awful movie, called Medicine Ball Caravan.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now you know from the 60s you're either on the bus or you're off the bus.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I was on the bus.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: My wife and I of 37 years joined the bus.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Our bus ride took us from San Francisco to London.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We switched buses at the Big Pond.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We then got on two more buses and we drove through Turkey and Iran, Afghanistan,

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: over the Khyber Pass into Pakistan like every other young doctor.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: This is us at the Khyber Pass and that's our bus.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We had some difficulty getting over the Khyber Pass,

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: but we wound up in India.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And then like everyone else in our generation we went to live in a Himalayan monastery.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: This is just like a residency program for those of you that are in medical school.

Filename: Larry Brilliant- My wish- Help me stop pandemics - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And we studied with a wise man, a guru named Kiroli Baba,

Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: If you're here today, and I'm very happy that you are,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: you've all heard about how sustainable development will save us from ourselves.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: However, when we're not at TED,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: we are often told that a real sustainability policy agenda is just not feasible,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: especially in large urban areas like New York City.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And that's because most people with decision-making powers

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: in both the public and the private sector

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: really don't feel as though they're in danger.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: The reason why I'm here today, in part, is because of a dog.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: An abandoned puppy I found back in the rain back in 1998,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: she turned out to be a much bigger dog than I'd anticipated.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: When she came into my life, we were fighting against a huge waste facility

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that planned for the East River waterfront.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Despite the fact that our small part of New York City

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: was already handled more than 40% of the entire city's commercial waste,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: a sewage treatment pelletizing plant,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: a sewage sludge plant, four power plants,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: the world's largest food distribution center,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: as well as other industries that bring more than 60,000 diesel truck trips

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to the area each week.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: The area also has one of the lowest ratios of parks to people in the city.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So when I was contacted by the Parks Department

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: about a $10,000 seed grant initiative to help develop waterfront projects,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I thought they were really well-meaning but a bit naive.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I'd lived in this area all my life,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and knew you could not get to the river

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: because of all the lovely facilities,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that I'd mentioned earlier.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Then while jogging with my dog one morning,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: she pulled me into what I thought was just another illegal dump.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: There were weeds and piles of garbage and other stuff that I won't mention here,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: but she kept dragging me,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and lo and behold, at the end of that lot was the river.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I knew that this forgotten little street end,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: abandoned like the dog that brought me there,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: was worth saving.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I knew it would grow to become the proud beginnings

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: of the community-led revitalization of the new South Bronx.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And just like my new dog,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: it was an idea that got bigger

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: than I'd imagined.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We garnered much support along the way,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and the Hunts Point Riverside Park became the first waterfront park

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that the South Bronx had had in more than 60 years.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We leveraged that $10,000 seed grant more than 300 times

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: into a $3 million park.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And in the fall, I'm actually going to exchange marriage vows

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: with my beloved.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Thank you very much.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: That's him pressing my buttons back there,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: which he does all the time.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But those of us living in environmental justice communities

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: are the canary in the coal mine.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We feel the problems right now, and have for some time.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Environmental justice, for those of you who may not be familiar with the term,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: goes something like this.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: No community should be saddled with more environmental burdens

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and less environmental benefits than any other.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Unfortunately, race and class are extremely reliable indicators as to where one might

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: find the good stuff, like parks and trees,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and where one might find the bad stuff, like power plants and waste facilities.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: As a black person in America, I am twice as likely as a white person

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to live in an area where air pollution poses the greatest risk to my health.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I am five times more likely to live within walking distance

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: of a power plant or a chemical facility, which I do.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: These land use decisions created the hostile conditions

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that lead to problems like obesity, diabetes, and asthma.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Why would someone leave their home to go for a brisk walk in a toxic neighborhood?

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Our 27% of the population in the United States, who are black, white, and white, are black.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Our national obesity rate is high even for this country, and diabetes comes with it.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: One out of four South Bronx children has asthma.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Our asthma hospitalization rate is seven times higher than the national average.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: These impacts are coming everyone's way, and we all pay dearly for solid waste costs,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: health problems associated with pollution, and more odiously,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: the cost of imprisoning our young black and Latino men

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: who possess untold amounts of untapped potential.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: 50% of our residents live at or below the poverty line.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: 25% of us are unemployed.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Low-income citizens often use emergency rooms

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: visits as primary care.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: This comes at a high cost to taxpayers and produces no proportional benefits.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Poor people are not only still poor, they are still healthy. Unhealthy.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Fortunately, there are many people like me who are striving for solutions

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that won't compromise the lives of low-income communities of color

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: in the short term and won't destroy us all in the long term.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: None of us want that, and we all have that in common.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So what else do we have in common?

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Well, first of all, we're all incredibly good-looking.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Graduated high school, college, post-graduate,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: traveled to interesting places, didn't have kids in your early teens,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: financially stable, never been imprisoned.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Okay, good.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But besides being a black woman,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I am different from most of you in some other ways.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I watched nearly half of the buildings in my neighborhood burn down.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: My big brother Lenny fought in Vietnam only to be gunned down

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: a few blocks from our home.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Jesus, I grew up with a crack house across the street.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Yeah, I'm a poor black child from the ghetto.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: These things make me different from you,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: but the things we have in common set me apart from most of the people in my community.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And I'm in between these two worlds with enough of my heart

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to fight for justice in the other.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So how did things get so different for us?

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: In the late 40s, my dad, a Pullman porter, son of a slave,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: bought a house in the Hunts Point section of the South Bronx,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and a few years later, he married my mom.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: At the time, the community was in a state of crisis.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It was a mostly white, working-class neighborhood.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: My dad was not alone, and as others like him

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: pursued their own version of the American dream,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: white flight became common in the South Bronx

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and in many cities around the country.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Redlining was used by banks wherein certain sections of the city,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: including ours, were deemed off-limits to any sort of investment.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Many landlords believed it was more profitable

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to torch their buildings and collect insurance money

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: rather than to sell under those conditions,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: dead or injured former tenants notwithstanding.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Hunts Point was formerly a walk-to-work community,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: but now residents had neither work nor home to walk to.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: A national highway construction boom was added to our problems.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: In New York State, Robert Moses spearheaded an aggressive highway expansion campaign.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: One of its primary goals was to make it easier for residents

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: of wealthy communities in Westchester County to go to Manhattan.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: The South Bronx, which lies in between, did not stand a chance.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Residents were often given less than a month's notice

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: before their buildings were razed.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: More than 100,000 people were displaced.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: The common perception was that only pimps and pushers

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and prostitutes were from the South Bronx.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And if you are told from your earliest days

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that nothing good is going to come from your community

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that is bad and ugly, how could it not reflect on you?

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So now, my family's property was worthless,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: save for that it was our home and all we had.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And luckily for me, that home and the love inside of it,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: along with help from teachers, mentors, and friends along the way,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: was enough.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now why is this story important?

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Because from a planning perspective, economic degradation begets

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: environmental degradation, which begets social degradation.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: The disinvestment that began in the 1960s set the stage

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: for all the environmental injustices that were to come.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Antiquated zoning and land use regulations are still used to this day

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to continue putting polluting facilities in my neighborhood.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Are these factors taken into consideration when land use policy is decided?

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: What costs are associated with this?

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Who makes these decisions?

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And who pays?

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Who profits?

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Does anything justify what the local community goes through?

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: This was planning, in quotes, that did not have our best interests in mind.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Once we realized that, we decided it was time to do our own planning.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: That small park I told you about earlier was the first stage

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: of building a greenway movement in the South Bronx.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I wrote a one and a quarter million dollar federal transportation grant

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to design the plan for a waterfront esplanade with dedicated on-street bike paths.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Physical improvements help inform public policy regarding traffic,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: safety, the placement of waste in other facilities,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: which if done properly, don't compromise the community's quality of life.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: They provide opportunities to be more physically active,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: as well as local economic development.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Think bike shops, juice stands.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We secured $20 million to build first phase projects.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: This is Lafayette Avenue, and that's redesigned by Matthews Nielsen Landscape Architects.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And once this path is constructed, it'll connect the South Bronx

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: with more than 400 acres of Randalls Island Park.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Right now we're separated by about 25 feet of water,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: but this link will change that.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And as we nurture the natural environment, its abundance will give us back even more.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We run a project called Bronx Ecological Stewardship Training,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: which provides job training in the fields of ecological restoration

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: so that folks from our community have the skills to compete for these well-paying jobs.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Little by little, we're seeding the area with green-collar jobs,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: the people that have both a financial and personal stake in their environment.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: The Sturgeon Expressway is an underutilized relic of the Robert Moses era,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: built with no regard for the environment.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It's a very isolated neighborhood, and neighborhoods that were divided by it.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Even during rush hour, it goes virtually unused.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: The community created an alternative transportation plan

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that allows for the removal of the highway.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We have the opportunity now to bring together all the stakeholders

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to re-envision how those 28 acres can be better utilized for parkland,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: affordable housing, and local economic development.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We also built the New York City's first green and cool-roof demonstration project

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: on top of our offices.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Cool roofs are highly reflective surfaces that don't absorb solar heat,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and pass it on to the building or atmosphere.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Green roofs are soil and living plants.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Both can be used instead of petroleum-based roofing materials that absorb heat,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: contribute to urban heat island effects, and degrade under the sun,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: which we in turn breathe.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Green roofs also retain up to 75% of rainfall,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: so they reduce a city's need to fund costly end-of-pipe solutions,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: which, incidentally, are often located in environmental justice communities like mine.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And they provide habitats for our little friends.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: So cool.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Anyway, the demonstration project is a springboard

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: for our own green roof installation business,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: bringing jobs and sustainable economic activity to the South Bronx.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I like that, too.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Anyway, I know Chris told us not to do pitches up here,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: but since I have all of your attention, we need investors.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: End of pitch. It's better to ask for forgiveness than permission.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Anyway.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Okay.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Katrina.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Prior to Katrina, the South Bronx and New Orleans Ninth Ward had a lot in common.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Both were largely populated by poor people of color.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Both hotbeds of cultural innovation. Think hip-hop and jazz.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Both are waterfront communities that host both industries and residents

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: in close proximity to one another.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: In the post-Katrina era, we have still more in common.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We're at best ignored and maligned and abused at worst.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: By negligent, racist, and violent,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: regulatory agencies, pernicious zoning,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: and lax governmental accountability.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Neither the destruction of the Ninth Ward nor the South Bronx was inevitable.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But we have emerged with valuable lessons about how to dig ourselves out.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: We are more than simply national symbols of urban blight

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: or problems to be solved by empty campaign promises of presidents come and gone.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now, will we let the Gulf Coast languish for a decade or two like the South Bronx did?

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Or will we take proactive steps and learn from the homegrown resource of grassroots,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: activists that have been born of desperation out in communities like mine?

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now, listen, I do not expect individuals, corporations, or government

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: to make the world a better place because it is right or moral.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: This presentation today only represents some of what I've been through.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Like a tiny little bit. You have no clue.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But I'll tell you later if you want to know.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But I know it's the bottom line or one's perception of it

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that motivates people in the end.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: I'm interested in what I like to call the triple bottom line

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: that sustainable development can produce.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Developments that have the potential to create positive returns

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: for all concerned.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: The developers, government, and the community where these projects go up.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: At present, that's not happening in New York City.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And we are operating with a comprehensive urban planning deficit.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: A parade of government subsidies is going to propose big box and stadium developments in the South Bronx.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: But there is scant coordination between city agencies

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: on how to deal with the cumulative effects

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: of increased traffic, pollution, solid waste, and the impacts on open space.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And their approaches to local economic and job development are so lame.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: It's not even funny.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Because on top of that, the world's richest sports team

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: is replacing the house that Ruth built by destroying two well-loved community parks.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now we'll have even less than that stat I told you about earlier.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: And although less than 25% of South Bronx residents own cars,

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: these projects include thousands of new parking spaces.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Yet, zip in terms of mass public transit.

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: Now what's missing from the larger debate

Filename: Majora Carter- Greening the ghetto - TED Talk.mp4
Text: is a comprehensive cost-benefit analysis

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 20 - Separasjon og.mp4
Text: Testseparatoren blir brukt til oppstart av nye brønner og brønntesting.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 20 - Separasjon og.mp4
Text: Når den blir brukt til oppstart av nye brønner kan oljen sendes direkte til oljeeksport,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 20 - Separasjon og.mp4
Text: mens når den brukes til brønntesting blir oljen ledet inn i prosessen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 20 - Separasjon og.mp4
Text: Separatoren har også en sandfelle på innløpsrøret som brukes for å verifisere sanddetektorene samt sjekke for eventuell sandproduksjon.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 20 - Separasjon og.mp4
Text: I tillegg til produksjon og testmanifold har P2 en transfermanifold.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 20 - Separasjon og.mp4
Text: Denne manifolden brukes til å overføre væske til P1 for å holde Flowlines varme under P2-nedstenging,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 20 - Separasjon og.mp4
Text: eller for å overføre olje fra DP til P2.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 20 - Separasjon og.mp4
Text: Det er lagt opp for jetting av første trinn, andre trinn og testseparator på begge plattformene,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 20 - Separasjon og.mp4
Text: da det vil legge seg sand i bunnen av separatoren over tid.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 20 - Separasjon og.mp4
Text: Jettevann tas ut fra System 44 og pumpes inn i dyser i separatorene.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 20 - Separasjon og.mp4

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Her ser du hele oljeeksportsystemet på Johan Sverdrup som er lokalisert på følgende plattform.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: P1, P2 og RP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Oljeeksport og målesystemene er plassert over disse tre plattformene, hvor oljen distribueres og måles på prosessplattformene P1 og P2, men eksporteres til mangstad fra reiserplattformen RP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: På P1 pumpes den stabiliserte oljen fra tredjetrinseparatorene med hver sin boosterpumpe, der en pumpe er i drift og en er i standby per olje.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Oljen pumpes via oljeeksportmålestasjonen, for den går videre til RP-plattformen via båreplattformen DP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Målestasjonen består av to strømningsmålere i serie.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: I forkant av målestasjonen er det også et avtak til et prøvekabinett som analyserer densitet og vanninnhold, og som inneholder et manuelt prøvepunkt.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Oljen pumpes over til RP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Da den skjøles ned i eksportskjølene i forkant av eksportledningen til mangstad.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Begge skjølene skal være i drift, men det er mulig å ta en ut for vedlikehold ved bruk av en felles omløpslinje uten at det skal påvirke produksjonen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Det er viktig at oljen ikke skjøles for mye ned, da det kan føre til vokstdannelse.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Vokstdannelsetemperaturen er estimert til 37 grader Celsius med en smeltetemperatur.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Oljen skal være på 56 grader.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Ved lav produksjon kan boosterpumpene brukes til å eksportere oljen direkte til eksportmanifagelen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: I et slikt tilfelle skal omløpslinjen over eksportpumpene benyttes, samt at smørolje og tetningssystemet til eksportpumpene må være i gang.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Omløpslinjen har en kapasitet på 16 000 standard kubikmeter i døgnet,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: som tilsvarer omtrent 2 eller 3 kubikmeter.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Oljen skal være på 32 grader Celsius med brønner.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: På P2 pumpes den stabiliserte oljen fra 30-trinnseparator med en av boosterpumpene, der en pumpe er i drift og en er i reserve.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Oljen blir utdannelig trykket opp av eksportpumpene før den går gjennom oljeeksportmålestasjonen og videre til RP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Målestasjonen består av en enkel strømningsmåler.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: I forkant av målestasjonen er det også et avtak til tetthetsmålestasjonen,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: B21JX002, som analyserer densitet og vanninnhold, og som også inneholder et manuelt prøvepunkt.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Ved lav produksjon sirkuleres oljen fra eksportpumpene tilbake til 30-trinnseparator gjennom resirkulasjonskjøleren.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: For å vedlikeholde rørledningen mot Mongstad er det planlagt å sende PIG fra RP-plattform til Mongstad ved behov.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: PIG-sluse?

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: PIG-slusen er plassert på RP og kan sende PIG under full oljeproduksjon.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 21_30 – Oljeeksport og.mp4
Text: Trykk på «Neste» for å gå videre.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Det finnes to gassløftsystemer på Johansverdruk.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Et på DP for tørre brønner, og et på RP mot subsiden.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Her ser du gassløftsystemet for tørre brønner, lokalisert på DP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Gassløftsystemet er koblet mot gaseksporterøret som går fra P1 til RP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Hensikten med systemet er å forsyne gass til gassløftsystemet på produksjonsbrønnene.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Injeksjoner av gass i brønnstrømmen reduserer tettheten og dermed tyngden av medier i brønnen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: System 26 er designet slik at en kan injisere gass i brønn 9 og 10 hvis gaseksporterøret til kåreste ikke er tilgjengelig.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: I system 26 reduseres gassstrykket til under 202 bar g, da dette er maksimalt trykk som tetningen mot reservaret i Anulis A tåler.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Gassløftsystemet er designet for 30 produksjonsbrønner.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Det er installert utstyr for måling av total mengde gass som brukes til gassløft og mengde gass som brukes til gassløft i hver brønn.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Her ser du gassløftsystemet for subsidbrønnene lokalisert på RP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Gassen kommer over bro for P2 og ledes til gaseksport og eller gassløft eller gassinspeksjon.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Gassen kommer tilbake til gasinjeksjonsmanifold.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Gassløftsystemet på RP er et kombinert gassløft- og gasinjeksjonssystem som leverer gass fra RP til subsid via tre stykk rørledninger.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Fra gassløft eller gassinjeksjonsmanifold blir gassen avrutet til de tre gassrørledningene som går mot subsid.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Hver av disse linjene er utstyrt med trykkkontrollvitiler som enten kan opprettholde trykket i manifold,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: eller styre trykket i rørledningen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Det er laget til et system som gjør det mulig å hente gass fra gassrørledningen som går fra brønnramme O, P eller Q,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: som kan brukes til trykkutligning av gaseksport stengeventil.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 26 Gassløft.mp4
Text: Det er også tilrettelegt for temporære sluser som kan både sende og motta pigger dersom det skulle bli behov.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Her ser du hele gasseksportsystemet på Johan Sveidrup, som er lokalisert på plattformen RP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Systemet er hovedsakelig delt inn i eksport av gass til Kårstø og import av gass fra eksportrørledningen for opptrykking av anleggene.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Gassen for eksport komprimeres i fjerde trinns kompressor på P1, før det går videre til RP via DP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Tilsvarende kommer det gass fra kompressoren på P2 over til RP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Noe av gassen vil bli tatt ut til bruk av gassinjeksjon eller gassløft på DP og eller subsea via RP, mens overskuddet eksporteres til Kårstø via eksportrørledningen, som er knyttet opp mot statpipe.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Systemet er utstyrt med en fiskal målestasjon.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Her måles og analyseres gassen fra Kårstø.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Det er også utstyrt med en fiskal målestasjon for å sikre at gasskvaliteten er i henhold til eksportspesifikasjonene.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: For å trykke opp Johans Veidrup-feltet i forbindelse med oppstart av trykkavlastet plattform, er det mulig å importere gass fra eksportrørledningen til både P1 og P2.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Den importerte gassen må gjennom en fiskal målestasjon, som måler mengden som importeres tilbake, da denne gassen allerede er solgt og må betales for.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Under opptrykking vil det oppstå lavetid.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Det er også mulig å importe gass fra en ekstra kjøretemperatur, og det er derfor behov for å varme opp gassen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Gassen varmes opp ved hjelp av importgassvarmer.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Rørledningen er utstyrt med en subsurface isolasjonsventil, som står på havbunnen ca. 100 meter fra plattformen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Isolasjonsventilen skal stenge og beskytte plattformen mot tilbakestrømming av gass ved brudd i stigerøret.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Systemet har også en piggsluise som benyttes for velikehold av stigerør og gaseksportrør.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Det er ikke planlagt regelmessig pigging av gaseksportrørledningen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Et typisk intervall for inspeksjonspigging vil være 10-15 år.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 27 - Gasseksport og.mp4
Text: Gass eksporterørledningen er utstyrt med en subsurface isolasjonsventil, som står på havbunnen ca. 100 meter fra plattformen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: Her ser du hele vanninjeksjonssystemet på Johan Sverdrup, som er lokalisert på plattformen RP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: Hensikten med vanninjeksjonssystemet er å

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: Oksygenfrit sjøvann fra system 50 og behandlet produsert vann fra system 44, tilføres fra P1 og P2, formater vanninjeksjonssystem på RP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: Vanninjeksjonssystemet består av to deler.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: En del som håndterer vann fra P1, og en del som håndterer vann fra P2.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: De to delene har en mulighet for sammenkobling nedstrømsinjeksjonspumpene.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: Oppstrøms er de to delene av systemet uavhengige.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: Pumper og distribusjonsmanifolder er plassert på RP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: Det er en sjøvannsmanifold og en produsert vannsmanifold som distribuerer vannet for injeksjon på DP,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: og i tillegg subsidbrønner i havbundsrammene E,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: F,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: G,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: H,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: P og Q.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: Vanninjeksjonssystemet er ikke sikkerhetskritisk, men det er kritisk for reservoirutvinning.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: Det er svært viktig å opprettholde god oppetid på disse pumpene for å sikre at planlagte årlige volymer av olje og gass blir utvinnet.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: Oksygenfritt sjøvann benyttes også til fracking av reservoiret,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 29 - Vanninjeksjon.mp4
Text: Fracking utføres ved hjelp av en multipurpose pumpe, MPP, lokalisert på DP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Her ser du systemene for brannvann og brannslukking, som er lokalisert på samtlige av Johan Sveidrups plattformer.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Begge systemene har en ringledning på hver plattform som distribuerer brannvann og skum.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Lokale sløyfer distribuerer brannvann og skum internt på hver plattform til blant annet hydranter, slangetromler og kombislukkere.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Brannvannsystemet har i hovedoppgave å levere brannvann til fastmonterte slukkesystem på alle installasjonene på Johan Sveidrups feltet.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Hensikten med det fastmonterte slukkesystemet er å begrense skader på personell og utstyr i forbindelse med branntilløp ved å levere slukkemedium til kjøling og slukking.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Brannvannsystemet forsynes med klorinert sjøvann fra tre brannpumpesystemer på LQ,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: og to på RP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Hvert av disse systemene består av en brannpumpekontainer som inneholder dieselmotor,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: generator,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: dieseldagtank,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: oljesirkuleringsenhet,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: sjøvannskjølesystem

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: og annet utstyr som er nødvendig for å operere brannpumpesystemet som en uavhengig enhet.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Brannpumpene pumper vann til en trykkutjevningstemp,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: som er en liten tank og videre inn på systemet.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Trykkutjevningstanken er utstyrt med en e-releaseventil for å eliminere skadelige trykkstøt ved oppstart av pumpen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Tanken og ventilen hindrer også luft fra stigerøret til pumpen i å endre brannvannsystemet.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Brannvannjokkipumper og en hydrofortank sørger for å opprettholde trykket i ringledningen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Jokkipumpene er plassert på LQ,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: og er i stedet for å opprettholde trykket i ringledningen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: De er med på å holde ringledningen trykksatt.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Pumpene er dimensjonert for å samtidig forsyne forbrukere uten at brannpumper skal starte.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Forbrukerne er

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: overbordrenering for frostbeskyttelse,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: sirkulering av klorinert sjøvann,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: tilbakestrømming til brannpumpekaisongene,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: forbruk opp til to brannhydranter,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: og forbruk av brannvannsystemer.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Hydrofortanksystemet er installert i brannvannsystemet,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: og skal forhindre kolonneseparasjon og påfølgende høye trykkpulser.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Hydrofortanken sørger for at vann trykkes inn i brannvannsystemet,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: holder dette vannfylt og trykksatt i den tiden det tar for brannpumpene å starte opp.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Brannslukkingssystemet leverer konsentrert brannskum til områder hvor brannvann alene ikke dekker behovet,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: på grunn av utstyrstypen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Det kan være branntype eller forventet branntype.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: I tillegg leverer systemet også vanntåket på LQ, RP og P2.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Vanntåkeanleggene er selvstendige enheter med vanntank for ferskvann,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: nitrogenflasker som drivmiddel,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: og forstøvning av vann til vanntåket til rommene.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Når vanntåket blir aktivert, vil nitrogen trykke opp vannet i tanken,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: samt distribuere nitrogen ut til lysene hvor vann og nitrogen blir mikset sammen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Systemet for brannskum er et sentralisert system og består av to skumskideenheter som er plassert på LQ og RP.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Skumskidene består av en skumtank og to skumpumper.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: I tillegg er det en skumjokkepumpe installert i hver skid.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Denne sørger for at trykket opprettholdes i skumringledningen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Deluge, monitor og sprinklerskid leverer brannvann og skum til delusjdyser, brannkanoner og sprinkler.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 71_72 - Brannvann og.mp4
Text: Polimodulen har også en DIFS som supplerer vann og skum til helidekket.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 80 - Hovedkraft, HVDC,.mp4
Text: Ved utfall på Haugsneset vil ikke bare Johan Sverdrup miste kraft fra land.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 80 - Hovedkraft, HVDC,.mp4
Text: Da vil også utsida Povagrid miste all kraft, og vi vil få en shutdown på samtlige plattformer tilknyttet til områdeløsningen.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 80 - Hovedkraft, HVDC,.mp4
Text: Og på grunn av dette er det viktig å ha god oversikt over prosedyreverket, og dette finner du i Satos.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 80 - Hovedkraft, HVDC,.mp4
Text: Her har vi samlet alle oppstartsprosedyre, helt ifra sjekk av UPS, normalisering av nødkraft og start av essensiell generator og HVDC-anlegg.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 80 - Hovedkraft, HVDC,.mp4
Text: Øverst til høyre, på tap av hovedkraft, finner du også prosedyre for innlegging av utsida Povagrid.

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 80 - Hovedkraft, HVDC,.mp4
Text: Sett deg gjerne inn i prosedyreverket for tap av hovedkraft for å få en bedre innsikt om hvordan oppstart på Johan Sverdrup,

Filename: Johan Sverdrup - System 80 - Hovedkraft, HVDC,.mp4
Text: og utsida Povagrid fungerer.
